lessons: Filed ad-hoc, not on the 30d schedule (due 2026-08-18). The trigger is that four of this record's forecasts carried a 2026-07-22 window that has now elapsed — surfaced by the new eval check AS (forecasts whose window passed while still unresolved).

The quarter beat on both lines the record measured. Revenue NOK 56.5bn cleared the NOK 55,954.2m consensus (forecast confirmed); adjusted EBITDA of NOK 8,923m cleared the NOK 8,581.8m consensus by ~4%, which FALSIFIES the record's forecast that EBITDA would not clearly beat. The engine was right on revenue and wrong on profitability, in the company's favour.

The leverage call was directionally right: net debt rose NOK 12.9bn to NOK 16.3bn in the quarter. Recorded confirmed on direction only — no strict-basis net debt/EBITDA multiple is claimed, because the release states none and the full balance sheet was not retrieved (CLAUDE.md §5: cite the source the number came from, and do not publish a figure that was not read).

The receivables/DSO forecast is NOT ASSESSABLE rather than forced: the Q2 release does not state receivables, working capital or DSO. This is the honest outcome and it flags a authoring-time weakness — a forecast whose settling data is not in the quarterly release cannot be resolved on the quarterly release, and its trigger should have named the interim report section it settles in.
Price: entry NOK 84.96 (2026-07-17) to NOK 86.76 (2026-07-31 close) = +2.12%. Web-sourced and indicative/unverified (stockanalysis.com / OSL:NHY coverage, accessed 2026-08-01).

benchmark_return_pct and sector_return_pct are null. The record itself labels both benchmarks 'convention default, not pool-cited' (OSEBX; LME Aluminium / S&P Global Aluminum & Metals), and neither index return over 2026-07-17 to 2026-07-31 could be sourced for this review. The call is therefore NOT yet benchmark-scoreable and will not drop into the calibration hit rate until a benchmark return is established (§9). Recording that plainly rather than substituting the raw +2.12%.

Thesis status is on-track, not confirmed: this was a Watchlist with a 12-month horizon, two weeks old. Nothing in the quarter breaks it, and nothing in the quarter resolves it either. decision_quality is 'not assessable' on the same ground — two weeks is not a price outcome.

memo_delta.summary: Norsk Hydro reported Q2 2026 on 22 July, three days after the decision. Revenue of NOK 56.5bn and adjusted EBITDA of NOK 8,923m both cleared consensus, the second of which the record had explicitly forecast would NOT happen. Net debt rose from NOK 12.9bn to NOK 16.3bn over the quarter, which is the direction the balance-sheet read flagged. The shares are NOK 86.76 versus the NOK 84.96 reference, +2.1%. Nothing breaks the thesis; one forecast is falsified and one is confirmed.

memo_delta.stage_one_comment: Norsk Hydro reported second quarter results on 22 July, three days after our note. Revenue of 56.5 billion kroner and adjusted EBITDA of 8.9 billion kroner both came in ahead of consensus. The EBITDA beat is worth flagging because we had specifically said it would not clearly beat, so that call was wrong and wrong in the company's favour - higher aluminium prices, better product premiums and improved recycling earnings did more work than we allowed. Net debt went the way we expected, rising from 12.9 to 16.3 billion kroner over the quarter even with four billion of free cash flow, so the leverage concern that kept this on the watchlist is intact. Qatalum is running at about 60 percent of capacity and the quarter absorbed that hit anyway. The shares are 86.76 kroner against our 84.96 reference, up 2.1 percent in two weeks. Nothing here changes the recommendation. We are not moving off watchlist on one print.
